title: States look to lidar, machine learning and satellites to map landslide risks
summary: New federal grants from the U.S. Geological Survey are helping states build landslide databases that can improve hazard mapping, emergency planning and public awareness.

title: Beyond the card: Why identity assurance is a required layer for payment security and government trust
summary: Accepting and disbursing payments are different operating models, but both depend on the same underlying question: Is the right person or entity involved in the transaction?

title: Colorado rescinds over $100M in BEAD awards after investigation into whistleblower complaints
summary: The whistleblower complaints about Colorado service provider Maverix Broadband involved “financial mismanagement and misuse of grant funds.”

title: Virginia Gov. Spanberger urges Congress to establish federal AI guardrails
summary: The governor’s push comes as states move ahead with their own AI policies addressing privacy workforce impacts, cybersecurity and the technology’s growing resource demands.

title: New York state CIO Dru Rai is out
summary: Jenson Jacob, who has been named acting CIO, said Rai’s departure Monday evening was “effective immediately.”

title: Maryland turns to civic tech to prepare for Medicaid changes
summary: The partnership will focus on redesigning member notices, simplifying applications and mapping caseworker processes to identify repetitive tasks that could be automated or streamlined.

title: Code for America gets Google funding to expand AI tax assistance
summary: The funding will support an AI-powered document screening tool for GetYourRefund, Code for America’s virtual tax-filing service.

title: Washington state names private sector tech leader as new chief information security officer
summary: Gwen Gann fills the CISO role left vacant by Ralph Johnson, who retired from Washington government this summer.

title: Newsom moves to speed up independent AI oversight in California with new executive order
summary: The order directs state officials to accelerate independent AI audits and create new safeguards for frontier models, including emergency “kill switches” and expanded reporting of critical safety incidents.

title: Federal grants target fingerprinting, licensing upgrades in child welfare systems
summary: The latest grants from the Administration for Children and Families aim to help modernize background check systems to speed foster family licensing and child placements.
